Package de.juniorjacki.remotebrick.devices

Class Motor

java.lang.Object
de.juniorjacki.remotebrick.devices.ConnectedDevice<Motor.MotorDataType>
de.juniorjacki.remotebrick.devices.Motor
public class Motor extends ConnectedDevice<Motor.MotorDataType>
Represents a motor connected to a LEGO Inventor Hub.

Provides real-time feedback via encoder: speed, position, relative position, and power. All control commands are executed through the Motor.MotorControl inner class.

Use getControl() to issue movement commands.
